card.name: Instruction wording in dosing and handling steps
card.fires_on: Ordinary words inside step-by-step directions or conditional clauses in drug labels, such as 'If the diagnosis', 'able to swallow', 'Prior to administration', 'Hold the syringe'. It lands on the word just before the expected next part of the instruction.

modes.label: Conditional clauses
modes.description: Words inside 'if/when' conditions about the patient's state or diagnosis.

card.plain: It marks mid-sentence words in label instructions and 'if' conditions, where a particular next word is expected.
